decision.reason: [ev-f44aa981165a] is only a table-of-contents heading. The section text [ev-dd988a5ed5c3] says to update provider manifests to "v2 versions" that support both cluster-scoped and namespaced managed resources, and says existing cluster-scoped managed resources keep working unchanged. It omits the actual provider versions and never says what happens to a Crossplane v2 cluster that keeps its older providers (failure, or just no namespaced managed resources). Without a version requirement and a stated consequence of inaction, the change and consequence aspects cannot be written; [ev-06a16cdbc869] does not settle this either.
